  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / 
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) as ratio
FROM budget b

WHERE b.category = 'Advertisement' 
  AND e.event_name IN ('Yearly Kickoff', 'October Meeting')
